name: The Skitterflute
fluff: This bone pipe reeks of the sewers, yet its notes carry a soundless tune that the vermin cannot resist.
text: Once per battle, the bearer may use the Gnawdoom magical ability without spending the ability dice to do so. Treat the ability value as 6.

name: The Sceptre of Count Steinhardt
fluff: This gilded and grotesque sceptre enforced count Steinhardt's rule long before anyone dared to ask what he worshipped in the cellars beneath his palace.
text: Counts as a Master-Wrought Club. If a melee attack action made by the bearer scores any critical hits, roll a dice. On a 4+, allocate 4 additional damage points to the target.

name: The Phylactery of Cassandora
fluff: Wearers struck down vanish in a flash of white light, only to reappear unharmed moments later.
text: Cannot be equipped by `VAMPIRES` or `DAEMONS`. Once per battle, when the bearer is the target of an attack action, when the totalled damage is enough to take the bearer out of action, roll a dice. On a 3+, the bearer is not taken out of action, and any damage points that remain to be allocated to the bearer are discarded.

name: Von Adelbrecht's Compass
fluff: A cracked shard of wyrdstone suspended in a rusted frame. It seems to guide the bearer toward concentrations of lingering spirits.
text: When the bearer is selected to explore a district, you may roll one additional exploration dice.

name: The Rope of Pieter
fluff: Twisted from shreds of old state banners, this rope stirs as though it has a will of its own, lengthening and coiling tight again at a whispered word.
text: Counts as a Rope and Hook. The bearer counts as flying in the first move action they make each battle round.

name: Grimoire of the Howling Choir
fluff: This grimoire is bound in scorched skin, and holds no spells but the sound of that fateful night when the comet struck. Open it, and the city screams again.
text: The bearer can open or close the grimoire as a free action. While opened, no fighter within 6" of the bearer (including the bearer) can use reactions or abilities.
